name: Indian ID check
summary: Check PAN, GSTIN, IFSC, UPI, Aadhaar numbers
author: friday-core
description: Validates the format and check digit of Indian identifiers: PAN (holder type), GSTIN (state code, embedded PAN, entity number, Z and the mod-36 check character), IFSC, PIN code, UPI id, mobile number and Aadhaar (Verhoeff checksum, never stored). A pass means the number is well formed, not that the person or firm exists or is active; verify on the official portal.
